title: How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
abstract: arXiv:2611.24728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapidly expanding generative AI landscape brings together methods that differ in architecture, learning objective, mathematical representation and sampling procedure. A concise, selectively organised technical guide can provide an accessible starting point for developing a coherent understanding of this increasingly complex landscape. This article takes a generation-centred approach, connecting how models produce new observations with the modelling and learning principles that make generation possible. We develop a two-level perspective: first, distinguishing three recurring generation routes-direct transformation or decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating or transport; and second, examining the modelling and learning principles underlying these routes. translated_title: 生成模型如何生成：生成式AI全景简明指南
translated_abstract: 快速扩张的生成式AI领域汇聚了在架构、学习目标、数学表示和采样过程上各不相同的方法。一份简洁且经过精选组织的技术指南，可以为理解这个日益复杂的领域提供一个易于入门的起点。本文采用以生成为中心的方法，将模型如何产生新观测与使生成成为可能的建模和学习原理联系起来。我们构建了一个两级视角：首先，区分出三种反复出现的生成路径——直接变换或解码、序贯条件构造以及迭代更新或输运；其次，考察这些路径背后的建模与学习原理。我们通过关键组件、学习目标和采样过程来介绍代表性方法，随后考察了它们更广泛的联系。
tldr: 本文提出以生成为中心的两级分析框架，区分出直接变换/解码、序贯条件构造和迭代更新/输运三种基本生成路径，并考察其背后的建模与学习原理，为理解复杂多样的生成式AI领域提供了简明统一的指南。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generation-centred, two-level framework that distinguishes three fundamental generation routes—direct transformation/decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating/transport—and examines the underlying modelling and learning principles, providing a concise unified guide to the generative AI landscape.
